name: dispenser-dispense-item
comment: WP-1.8 BlockDispenser powered by a redstone torch. A dispenser at (0,61,0) (facing 3); at t=2 a lit redstone torch (76) at (-1,61,0) with metadata 1, attached to a stone at (-2,61,0) (metadata given, so BlockTorch.onBlockAdded keeps it). BlockRedstoneTorch.onBlockAdded notifies around it; the dispenser's onNeighborBlockChange sees a power source and isBlockIndirectlyGettingPowered (the torch powers side 4) and schedules a tick (tickRate 4); updateTick then dispenseItem: the inventory is empty (no op can fill a tile entity), so getRandomStackFromInventory draws nothing and the result is the 1001 click. scheduled_ticks (full) and rng_state every tick. Needs BlockRedstoneTorch (redstone task of WP-1.6) in the port.
